title: HelperSSHToolSocketResult
description: The tool socket's identity, so the caller can end it with the same `unforward` every other listener is ended by, and the path that was asked for — echoed rather than re-derived, because the caller named it and a second derivation is how two answers to 'where is this socket' start disagreeing.

forward.description: The listener id, as 32 hex characters. Minted by the helper — the end that owns the listener — and echoed verbatim by the coordinator on the unforward that ends it.

path.description: The far-host path the socket was bound at, as the caller named it.
